How it works

From awareness
to Splendid

A structured journey — not guesswork. Seven steps, one goal.

1
You recognise the problem
You know something needs to change — energy, body composition, confidence. You're aware and looking for a solution that actually fits your life.
2
Book a Fitness Strategy Session
A free 30-minute call with Coach Tushar. No pressure — just an honest conversation about your goals, lifestyle, and what's possible for you.
Book in 60 seconds ↓
3
We map out the process on the call
We walk you through exactly how the S2S system works. If in-person suits you, we also book your S2S Fit — 7 Levels of Fitness Assessment.
In-person option available
4
Assessment → Onboarding
After your assessment, we onboard you into the S2S system — Everfit app, profile setup, and all the data we need to build your plan.
Everfit app set up
5
7-Day S2S Fitness Audit
Your first week is an observation phase. We watch how you move, respond to training, and eat in real life. Daily check-ins on Everfit. This builds the foundation of your plan.
7 days · Daily check-ins
6
Your Master Plan is built
With audit data, we build your complete personalised plan — training blocks, South Asian nutrition macros, recovery, and lifestyle accommodations. Full resource allocation.
Fully personalised · 48hr delivery
7
Execute → Assess → Re-strategise → Repeat
We implement, track, adapt, and keep you progressing. Weekly reviews, WhatsApp support, and program adjustments. We repeat until you hit your goals — then climb the next S2S level.
Ongoing · Level by level
